===
sloplint: bare escape sequence as a command argument
===

Write-Host `r`n

---

(program
  (statement_list
    (pipeline
      (pipeline_chain
        (command
          (command_name)
          (command_elements
            (command_argument_sep)
            (generic_token)))))))
